Has anyone worked on defining the category Stoch (measurable spaces + Markov kernels) as a symmetric monoidal category in Mathlib? We're formalizing conditional independence and running into the product
associativity issue described in arXiv:2506.18616.
Not answering your question, but we already have (versions of) conditional independence in Mathlib, see docs#ProbabilityTheory.CondIndepFun
